modalities.evidence: dual-task conditions (walking while performing serial subtractions)

output.population: Healthy adults aged 50-79 in the Greater Boston area: 60 Tai Chi-naive subjects randomized to Tai Chi or usual care, plus 27 healthy Tai Chi experts
output.summary: Gait and muscle-activity recordings from older adults walking under normal and dual-task conditions, from a Tai Chi trial plus an observational group of experienced Tai Chi practitioners.
